question_text: A 41-year-old man, diagnosed with bipolar disorder, who has performed an over-supply of lithium carbonate, comes to the emergency room. The exploration highlights intense tremor, ataxia, dysarthria and a vertical nystagmus. A litemia is obtained that is 4.1 mEq / L. What is the best therapeutic option?
